source.objectiveEnglish: Ask a server politely for the bill, water or the check, and give simple usted commands.
source.focusEnglish: Polite requests with ¿Puede...? and ¿Me puede...?, and usted commands like tráigame
source.speakingEnglish: Ask a server for a glass of water and the bill, pay in cash, and tell them to keep the change.

archivedDraft.scene: Sam finishes breakfast and asks staff how to pay.

priorProposal.status: retained separately; no automatic audio or saved-item mapping

sourceCards.sourceNote: If unsure, ask: ¿La propina está incluida?
Mexican word; in other countries it is el pitillo or la pajilla.

sourceCards.sourceEnglish: Could you bring me the bill, please?
sourceCards.targetJapaneseDraft: お会計をお願いできますか
sourceCards.literalJapaneseGlossEn: Could I ask for the bill?

sourceCards.sourceSpanish: ¿Me puede dar un vaso de agua?
sourceCards.sourceEnglish: Can you give me a glass of water?
sourceCards.targetJapaneseDraft: お水を一杯いただけますか
sourceCards.literalJapaneseGlossEn: Could I have a glass of water?

sourceCards.sourceNote: Usted command of traer; add por favor to keep it polite.
sourceCards.targetJapaneseDraft: クリームをもっと持ってきてください

sourceCards.sourceNote: Say it when you leave the change as the tip.
sourceCards.targetJapaneseDraft: おつりは取っておいてください

sourceSettingReader.speaker: Narrator
sourceSettingReader.sourceSpanish: Anna desayuna huevos y café en una cafetería de Oaxaca.
sourceSettingReader.sourceEnglish: Anna eats eggs and coffee for breakfast at a café in Oaxaca.
sourceSettingReader.targetJapaneseDraft: アンナはオアハカのカフェで、朝食に卵を食べ、コーヒーを飲みます。
sourceSettingReader.literalJapaneseGlossEn: Anna eats eggs and drinks coffee for breakfast at a café in Oaxaca.

sourceSettingReader.speaker: Anna
sourceSettingReader.sourceSpanish: Anna: ¿Me puede dar un vaso de agua?
sourceSettingReader.sourceEnglish: Anna: Can you give me a glass of water?
sourceSettingReader.targetJapaneseDraft: お水を一杯いただけますか。
sourceSettingReader.literalJapaneseGlossEn: Could I have a glass of water?

sourceSettingReader.speaker: Narrator
sourceSettingReader.sourceSpanish: Luis, el mesero, trae agua con hielo y un popote.
sourceSettingReader.sourceEnglish: Luis, the server, brings water with ice and a straw.
sourceSettingReader.targetJapaneseDraft: 店員のルイスは、氷入りの水とストローを持ってきます。
sourceSettingReader.literalJapaneseGlossEn: Staff member Luis brings water with ice and a straw.

sourceSettingReader.speaker: Anna
sourceSettingReader.sourceSpanish: Anna: ¿Me puede traer la sal, por favor?
sourceSettingReader.sourceEnglish: Anna: Can you bring me the salt, please?
sourceSettingReader.targetJapaneseDraft: お塩を持ってきていただけますか。

sourceSettingReader.speaker: Anna
sourceSettingReader.sourceSpanish: Anna: Tráigame más crema, por favor.
sourceSettingReader.sourceEnglish: Anna: Please bring me more cream.
sourceSettingReader.targetJapaneseDraft: クリームをもっと持ってきてください。

sourceSettingReader.speaker: Anna
sourceSettingReader.sourceSpanish: Anna: ¿Puede traerme la cuenta, por favor?
sourceSettingReader.sourceEnglish: Anna: Could you bring me the bill, please?
sourceSettingReader.targetJapaneseDraft: お会計をお願いできますか。
sourceSettingReader.literalJapaneseGlossEn: Could I ask for the bill?

sourceSettingReader.speaker: Luis
sourceSettingReader.sourceSpanish: Luis: ¿Va a pagar con tarjeta o en efectivo?
sourceSettingReader.sourceEnglish: Luis: Are you going to pay by card or in cash?
sourceSettingReader.targetJapaneseDraft: カードと現金、どちらでお支払いになりますか。
sourceSettingReader.literalJapaneseGlossEn: Will you pay by card or in cash?

sourceSettingReader.speaker: Anna
sourceSettingReader.sourceSpanish: Anna: En efectivo, aquí tiene 200 pesos.
sourceSettingReader.sourceEnglish: Anna: In cash, here are 200 pesos.
sourceSettingReader.targetJapaneseDraft: 現金で払います。二百ペソ、どうぞ。
sourceSettingReader.literalJapaneseGlossEn: I will pay in cash. Here are 200 pesos.

sourceSettingReader.speaker: Anna
sourceSettingReader.sourceSpanish: Anna: Quédese con el cambio de propina.
sourceSettingReader.sourceEnglish: Anna: Keep the change as a tip.
sourceSettingReader.targetJapaneseDraft: おつりはチップとして取っておいてください。
sourceSettingReader.literalJapaneseGlossEn: Please keep the change as a tip.
